captions: [{"start":0.03,"end":3.18,"text":"In February, 2026, an auction changed"},{"start":3.21,"end":5.44,"text":"how the AI boom is measured."},{"start":5.47,"end":7.85,"text":"PJM, the grid operator for 13"},{"start":7.88,"end":10.74,"text":"American states, held its annual capacity"},{"start":10.77,"end":11.52,"text":"auction."},{"start":11.55,"end":12.81,"text":"The price cleared at a record"},{"start":12.84,"end":16.06,"text":"$329 per megawatt day, the"},{"start":16.09,"end":18.55,"text":"highest ever allowed, because, for the"},{"start":18.58,"end":20.08,"text":"first time, the grid could not"},{"start":20.11,"end":22.56,"text":"fully guarantee the power it promised."},{"start":22.59,"end":23.96,"text":"Here is the part that surprised"},{"start":23.99,"end":24.57,"text":"people."},{"start":24.57,"end":26.54,"text":"The auction monitor says data centers"},{"start":26.67,"end":29.03,"text":"drove about $6.3 billion of that"},{"start":29.06,"end":31.71,"text":"cost, 38% of the entire bill."},{"start":31.83,"end":33.02,"text":"That is the question we are"},{"start":33.05,"end":34.06,"text":"going to unpack."},{"start":34.09,"end":35.31,"text":"Can the world's grids grow as"},{"start":35.34,"end":38.16,"text":"quickly as AI's demand for electricity?"},{"start":38.19,"end":39.27,"text":"The short answer is that the"},{"start":39.3,"end":41.4,"text":"constraint on AI has moved."},{"start":41.43,"end":42.76,"text":"It used to be chips."},{"start":42.79,"end":44.32,"text":"Now it is cables."},{"start":44.35,"end":46.28,"text":"Start with the load itself."},{"start":46.31,"end":47.86,"text":"A modern AI data center is"},{"start":47.89,"end":49.82,"text":"a building filled with thousands of"},{"start":49.85,"end":51.63,"text":"servers running around the clock, with"},{"start":51.66,"end":53.88,"text":"liquid cooling and backup power stacked"},{"start":53.91,"end":54.48,"text":"on top."},{"start":54.51,"end":55.93,"text":"One large campus can draw as"},{"start":55.96,"end":57.89,"text":"much electricity as a small city"},{"start":57.92,"end":59.88,"text":"around a gigawatt or more."},{"start":59.91,"end":62.16,"text":"Northern Virginia, the world's largest data"},{"start":62.19,"end":64.43,"text":"center cluster, now consumes more power"},{"start":64.46,"end":66.16,"text":"than some small countries."},{"start":66.19,"end":67.69,"text":"The servers that answer your prompts"},{"start":67.72,"end":70.84,"text":"are, quite literally, a city-sized machine."},{"start":70.87,"end":72.64,"text":"This is the definition we need."},{"start":72.67,"end":73.84,"text":"A data center is not a"},{"start":73.87,"end":74.72,"text":"building."},{"start":74.75,"end":76.28,"text":"It is a demand curve, and"},{"start":76.31,"end":78.34,"text":"that demand curve is climbing fast."},{"start":78.37,"end":80.71,"text":"The International Energy Agency now projects"},{"start":80.74,"end":83.01,"text":"global data center electricity use will"},{"start":83.04,"end":85.62,"text":"roughly double by 2030, from around"},{"start":85.65,"end":88.72,"text":"500 terawatt hours to about 950,"},{"start":88.75,"end":91.25,"text":"with AI-specific capacity tripling over the"},{"start":91.28,"end":92.28,"text":"same period."},{"start":92.31,"end":94.08,"text":"That is not a rounding error."},{"start":94.11,"end":95.33,"text":"That is like adding a second"},{"start":95.36,"end":97.76,"text":"Japan to the world's electricity system."},{"start":97.79,"end":99.4,"text":"Now follow the chain."},{"start":99.43,"end":101.97,"text":"The AI stack runs chips, memory,"},{"start":102,"end":103.96,"text":"storage, and cooling, and every layer"},{"start":103.99,"end":105,"text":"is electricity."},{"start":105.03,"end":106.66,"text":"The bottleneck is no longer the"},{"start":106.69,"end":107.46,"text":"chip plant."},{"start":107.49,"end":109.13,"text":"It is the grid connection, the"},{"start":109.16,"end":111.68,"text":"transformer, the transmission line that brings"},{"start":111.71,"end":112.92,"text":"power to the machine."},{"start":112.95,"end":114.58,"text":"Here is where the market comes"},{"start":114.61,"end":114.92,"text":"in."},{"start":114.99,"end":116.49,"text":"In the United States, the queue"},{"start":116.52,"end":117.92,"text":"of projects waiting to connect to"},{"start":117.95,"end":121.16,"text":"the grid holds roughly 2,600 gigawatts"},{"start":121.19,"end":122.22,"text":"of requests."},{"start":122.25,"end":124.49,"text":"Median weights have stretched past five"},{"start":124.52,"end":125.1,"text":"years."},{"start":125.13,"end":127.1,"text":"A data center cannot wait five"},{"start":127.23,"end":128.7,"text":"years, so the hyperscalers are going"},{"start":128.73,"end":129.68,"text":"around the queue."},{"start":129.71,"end":131.67,"text":"Microsoft struck a deal to restart"},{"start":131.81,"end":133.08,"text":"Three Mile Island."},{"start":133.11,"end":136.64,"text":"Amazon backed Xenergies' small modular reactors."},{"start":136.67,"end":138.74,"text":"Google signed up Kairos, and meta"},{"start":138.77,"end":140.16,"text":"chose Terra Power."},{"start":140.19,"end":141.66,"text":"When the grid cannot deliver fast"},{"start":141.69,"end":143.75,"text":"enough, the biggest buyers are building"},{"start":143.78,"end":145.16,"text":"their own power plants."},{"start":145.19,"end":146.96,"text":"That is why markets care."},{"start":146.99,"end":149.2,"text":"Electricity is becoming the binding input"},{"start":149.23,"end":150.94,"text":"for the most valuable companies on"},{"start":150.97,"end":153.28,"text":"Earth, and whoever controls power supply"},{"start":153.31,"end":155.08,"text":"is capturing the toll booth."},{"start":155.11,"end":156.88,"text":"So what is the honest uncertainty?"},{"start":156.91,"end":158.88,"text":"Nuclear is clean and steady, but"},{"start":159.01,"end":160.52,"text":"slow and expensive."},{"start":160.55,"end":161.98,"text":"Gas is fast, but it is"},{"start":162.01,"end":163.36,"text":"a fossil fuel and it is"},{"start":163.39,"end":164.16,"text":"pricey."},{"start":164.19,"end":166.26,"text":"Renewables are getting cheaper, but they"},{"start":166.29,"end":168.72,"text":"need land, transmission, and storage."},{"start":168.75,"end":170.72,"text":"No single answer can scale fast"},{"start":170.85,"end":171.76,"text":"enough on its own."},{"start":171.79,"end":173.08,"text":"The signal to watch is not"},{"start":173.11,"end":174.44,"text":"the headline number."},{"start":174.47,"end":176.52,"text":"It is the behavior underneath it."},{"start":176.55,"end":178.81,"text":"Watch whether utilities can actually connect"},{"start":178.84,"end":180.81,"text":"data centers without breaking the grid"},{"start":180.84,"end":181.74,"text":"for everyone else."},{"start":181.77,"end":183.26,"text":"Watch whether the new nuclear and"},{"start":183.29,"end":185.34,"text":"gas deals come online on time."},{"start":185.37,"end":187.44,"text":"Watch whether efficiency gains can slow"},{"start":187.47,"end":189.14,"text":"the curve because AI can use"},{"start":189.17,"end":191.16,"text":"less electricity per task, but it"},{"start":191.19,"end":192.84,"text":"keeps finding more tasks."},{"start":192.91,"end":194.98,"text":"The AI race was about models,"},{"start":195.01,"end":196.32,"text":"then it was about chips."},{"start":196.35,"end":198.16,"text":"Now it is about megawatts."},{"start":198.19,"end":199.25,"text":"The grid was built for a"},{"start":199.28,"end":200.67,"text":"world where power grew a few"},{"start":200.7,"end":201.66,"text":"percent a year."},{"start":201.69,"end":202.97,"text":"AI wants a world where it"},{"start":203,"end":204.28,"text":"can grow on demand."},{"start":204.31,"end":205.8,"text":"That is the tension."},{"start":205.83,"end":208.04,"text":"And in 2026, it has a"},{"start":208.07,"end":210.37,"text":"price tag, a record auction, a"},{"start":210.4,"end":213.61,"text":"2,600 gigawatt queue, and a race"},{"start":213.64,"end":215.13,"text":"to build the power plants that"},{"start":215.16,"end":217.26,"text":"will decide who gets to compute."},{"start":217.29,"end":218.7,"text":"The question for the next phase"},{"start":218.73,"end":220.54,"text":"of the AI economy is not"},{"start":220.57,"end":222.52,"text":"whether the models get better."},{"start":222.55,"end":223.75,"text":"It is whether the lights stay"},{"start":223.78,"end":224.86,"text":"on while they do."}]
